rules.name: MSME-1 filing - April to September
rules.law: Companies Act 2013 read with MSMED Act
rules.description: Half-yearly return for outstanding MSME payments during April-September, due by 31st October

actions.description: Generate MSME-1 filing draft for Apr-Sep period

rules.legal_text: Every specified company shall file a half-yearly return in Form MSME-1 regarding outstanding amounts to Micro and Small enterprises.
rules.penalty_description: Fine up to INR 25,000 for officers in default

rules.name: MSME-1 filing - October to March
rules.law: Companies Act 2013 read with MSMED Act
rules.description: Half-yearly return for outstanding MSME payments during October-March, due by 30th April

actions.description: Generate MSME-1 filing draft for Oct-Mar period

rules.legal_text: Every specified company shall file a half-yearly return in Form MSME-1 regarding outstanding amounts to Micro and Small enterprises.
rules.penalty_description: Fine up to INR 25,000 for officers in default
